market.browserDataCookiesHint: Clear sign-ins and stored data for all sites on this device, regardless of the time range.
market.browserDataCacheHint: Clear all web caches on this device. Sites may load more slowly next time.
market.browserDataTabsHint: Close tabs visited on this device during the selected time range.
market.browserDataPasswordHint: Delete passwords saved or updated during this time range, including on your other devices.
market.browserDataConfirm: Delete the selected data? History and password deletions sync to your other devices. This cannot be undone.
market.browserDataFailed: Some data could not be deleted. Please try again.
market.browserDataLocal: Saved on this device only. Sign in to sync account data.
market.browserDataSynced: Synced to your account. Changes on other devices update automatically.
market.browserDataOffline: Not synced yet. We'll retry when the connection returns.
market.browserDataStorage: Could not save on this device. Check available storage and try again.
market.browserDataConflict: Another device created a different vault. Your local data is preserved; resolve the vault conflict first.
market.browserDataCapacity: Storage is full. Delete unneeded records and try again.
market.browserDataWebHint: Web apps cannot clear other sites' cookies or caches. Use your browser settings to clear them.
market.browserPasswordSaveHint: Check the site and username before saving. Your password is encrypted and synced to your other devices.
market.browserPasswordDeleteConfirm: Delete this password? It will also be deleted on your other devices.
market.browserPasswordInvalid: Enter a valid HTTPS website address and a password.
market.browserPasswordWebHint: Web apps cannot fill passwords on other sites. View them here or use your browser's password manager.
market.browserPasswordFillFailed: No login form found for this site. Check the current page and try again.
market.browserVaultHint: Use a separate passphrase to encrypt passwords. Enter it on new devices. It cannot be recovered if forgotten. Use at least 12 characters.
market.browserVaultUnlockHint: Unlock once on this device to keep using your synced passwords, even after restarting or switching apps.
market.browserVaultFailed: Incorrect passphrase or vault unavailable. Please try again.
market.browserVaultMismatch: Both passphrases must match and contain at least 12 characters.

market.browserVaultCorrupt: Some passwords could not be decrypted. Their original data has been preserved.
